notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Matraquinha PAIR and for your feedback!
This is a small update to bring back the achievements for finding all objects in a scene with 3 stars. 
On the first session after the update, the achievements for the scenes already completed will be recognized.
Thanks for your patience and support!
Best regards.
